nvitk.measure
=============

.. py:module:: nvitk.measure

.. autoapi-nested-parse::

   Image measurements: volume, intensity, SUV, voxel-based overlap, surface
   distance, radiomics, and intensity correlation.

   Two APIs are provided:

   1. **Functional primitives** (the public core). Each one takes a
      :class:`~nvitk.types.Image` (or raw array + spacing) and returns a ``dict``
      (or ``Image`` when it returns derived voxels). They are pure functions
      and backend-aware.
   2. **A thin :class:`Measurer` orchestrator** (see :mod:`nvitk.measure.measurer`)
      that binds an (image, mask) pair once, optionally aligns them, and lets you
      chain ``.volume()``, ``.intensity()``, ``.suv()``, ``.voxel_metrics(ref)``
      etc. without retyping the inputs.

   Example::

       from nvitk.measure import volume_cc, masked_stats, Measurer

       vol = volume_cc(mask)
       stats = masked_stats(pet, mask, stats=("mean", "max", "p95"))

       m = Measurer(pet, mask).align("raw_to_mask")
       df = (
           m.volume()
            | m.intensity(stats=("mean", "max"))
            | m.suv(kinds=("bw",))
       )

.. py:function:: correlation_stats(a: Any, b: Any) -> dict[str, float]

   Return Pearson r/p, Spearman r/p, MAE, RMSE, mean % difference, and per-array summaries.

   Arithmetic (diff / means / std) runs on the active backend; ``scipy.stats``
   is the single host hop.


.. py:function:: pearson(a: Any, b: Any) -> tuple[float, float]

   Return ``(pearson_r, pearson_p)`` for two 1-D arrays.


.. py:function:: rmse(a: Any, b: Any) -> float

   Root mean squared error.


.. py:function:: sample_at_physical_points(image: nvitk.types.Image | Any, affine: Any | None = None, physical_points: Any = None, *, order: int = 3, mode: str = 'constant', cval: float = 0.0) -> Any

   Sample *image* at *physical_points* (world coordinates) using the provided *affine*.

   When *image* is an :class:`Image` and *affine* is None, ``image.affine`` is used.
   *physical_points* is an ``(N, 3)`` array-like of world coordinates.

   Returns an ``(N,)`` NumPy array of sampled values (cubic interpolation by default).

   .. rubric:: Notes

   The 4×4 affine inversion runs on the host (trivial cost) using
   ``numpy.linalg.inv``. The heavy voxel sampling (``ndi.map_coordinates``) uses
   the proxy ``ndi``, so it runs on GPU when the active backend is CuPy.


.. py:function:: spearman(a: Any, b: Any) -> tuple[float, float]

   Return ``(spearman_r, spearman_p)`` for two 1-D arrays.


.. py:function:: masked_stats(image: nvitk.types.Image | Any, mask: nvitk.types.Image | Any, *, stats: Iterable[str] = ('mean', 'median', 'max', 'p95', 'std', 'sum')) -> dict[str, float]

   Compute a set of intensity statistics for *image* restricted to ``mask > 0``.

   :param image: Intensity image.
   :param mask: Label or binary mask image/array with same shape as *image*.
   :param stats: Iterable of stat names to compute. Supported:
                 ``mean``, ``median``, ``max``, ``min``, ``p95``, ``p5``, ``std``, ``sum``, ``count``.

   :returns: Plain Python floats (CuPy arrays are materialized to host at the tail of the pipeline).
   :rtype: dict[str, float]


.. py:class:: Measurer

   Bind an intensity/raw image and a segmentation mask together.

   Instances are immutable; transformations like :meth:`align` return a new
   :class:`Measurer`. All measurement methods return plain :class:`dict`\s.


   .. py:attribute:: image
      :type:  nvitk.types.Image


   .. py:attribute:: mask
      :type:  nvitk.types.Image


   .. py:method:: align(direction: str = 'mask_to_raw', *, method: str = 'affine', order: int | None = None) -> Measurer

      Resample image or mask so both share a grid.

      :param direction: ``'raw_to_mask'`` (default) -> image resampled to mask's grid.
                        ``'mask_to_raw'`` -> mask resampled to image's grid.
      :param method: Currently only ``'affine'``.
      :param order: Interpolation order. Defaults to 1 for image and 0 for mask.



   .. py:method:: with_mask(mask: nvitk.types.Image) -> Measurer

      Return a new :class:`Measurer` with *mask* swapped in (same image).



   .. py:method:: with_image(image: nvitk.types.Image) -> Measurer

      Return a new :class:`Measurer` with *image* swapped in (same mask).



   .. py:method:: volume() -> dict[str, float]

      Physical volume of the mask in mm³ and cc.



   .. py:method:: intensity(*, stats: Iterable[str] = ('mean', 'median', 'max', 'p95', 'std', 'sum')) -> dict[str, float]

      Requested intensity statistics of the image within the mask.



   .. py:method:: suv(*, kinds: Iterable[str] = ('bw', ), stats: Iterable[str] = ('mean', 'median', 'max', 'min', 'std', 'p95', 'p5', 'p99'), philips: bool = True, revert_scaling: bool = False, metadata: dict[str, Any] | None = None) -> dict[str, float]

      SUV statistics within the mask (BW/BSA/LBM kinds), from the image's PET metadata.



   .. py:method:: suv_image(*, kind: str = 'bw', philips: bool = True, revert_scaling: bool = False) -> nvitk.types.Image

      Return the full SUV-converted :class:`Image` (unmasked).



   .. py:method:: integrated_intensity() -> float

      Sum of intensity × voxel-volume over the mask (e.g. total lesion glycolysis).



   .. py:method:: voxel_metrics(reference: nvitk.types.Image, *, metrics: Iterable[str] | None = None) -> dict[str, float]

      Overlap metrics (dice/jaccard/…) of this mask against a *reference* mask.



   .. py:method:: surface_metrics(reference: nvitk.types.Image, *, metrics: Iterable[str] | None = None) -> dict[str, float]

      Surface-distance metrics (hausdorff/msd/…) of this mask against a *reference* mask.



   .. py:method:: radiomics(*, feature_classes: Iterable[str] | None = None) -> dict[str, float]

      PyRadiomics feature values for the image within the mask.



   .. py:method:: correlation(other: nvitk.types.Image) -> dict[str, float]

      Pearson/Spearman/MAE/RMSE between self.image and *other* on ``self.mask > 0``.



.. py:function:: compute_radiomics(image: nvitk.types.Image | Any, mask: nvitk.types.Image | Any, *, feature_classes: Iterable[str] | None = None, spacing: tuple[float, Ellipsis] | None = None) -> dict[str, float]

   Compute PyRadiomics first-order / shape features for (*image*, *mask*).

   :param image: Intensity image. May be ``None`` only when ``feature_classes == {'shape'}``.
   :param mask: Binary/label mask with the same shape as *image*.
   :param feature_classes: Iterable of class names. Defaults to ``('firstorder', 'shape')``.
   :param spacing: Explicit spacing in mm. Defaults to the mask's :attr:`Image.spacing`.

   :returns: Feature names are normalized to ``fo_...`` / ``s_...`` prefixes.
   :rtype: dict[str, float]


.. py:function:: integrated_intensity(raw: nvitk.types.Image | Any, mask: nvitk.types.Image | Any) -> float

   Integrated intensity of *raw* over ``mask > 0`` (unit-less sum).


.. py:function:: hausdorff(label_true: Any, label_pred: Any, *, spacing: tuple[float, Ellipsis] | None = None) -> float

   Hausdorff distance (mm): the worst-case surface-to-surface distance between two masks.


.. py:function:: hausdorff95(label_true: Any, label_pred: Any, *, spacing: tuple[float, Ellipsis] | None = None) -> float

   95th-percentile Hausdorff distance (mm): robust to a few outlier surface voxels.


.. py:function:: mdsd(label_true: Any, label_pred: Any, *, spacing: tuple[float, Ellipsis] | None = None) -> float

   Median surface distance (mm) between the two mask boundaries.


.. py:function:: msd(label_true: Any, label_pred: Any, *, spacing: tuple[float, Ellipsis] | None = None) -> float

   Mean surface distance (mm) between the two mask boundaries.


.. py:function:: stdsd(label_true: Any, label_pred: Any, *, spacing: tuple[float, Ellipsis] | None = None) -> float

   Standard deviation of surface distances (mm) — boundary agreement spread.


.. py:function:: surface_metrics(label_true: Any, label_pred: Any, *, spacing: tuple[float, Ellipsis] | None = None, metrics: Iterable[str] | None = None) -> dict[str, float]

   Compute multiple surface metrics in one pass (all sharing the same distance array).


.. py:function:: suv_image(pet: nvitk.types.Image | Any, metadata: Dict[str, Any] | None = None, *, kind: str = 'bw', philips: bool = False, revert_scaling: bool = False) -> nvitk.types.Image | Any

   Convert a raw PET image to an SUV image.

   :param pet: PET image. If an :class:`Image`, *metadata* defaults to ``pet.metadata``.
   :param metadata: DICOM-style metadata. Required if *pet* is a bare array.
   :param kind: ``bw``, ``lbm``, ``bsa``, or ``ibw`` (also accepts legacy ``SUVbw``...).
   :param philips: If True (default) and the Philips ``(7053,1000)`` SUV factor is present,
                   use that as a direct multiplier. Set to False to always compute from
                   half-life/weight.
   :param revert_scaling: If True, undo scanner-applied ``RescaleSlope/Intercept`` per slice before
                          applying the SUV factor.

   :returns: SUV image. Matches the input type (``Image`` in -> ``Image`` out).
   :rtype: Image | ndarray


.. py:function:: suv_stats(pet: nvitk.types.Image | Any, mask: nvitk.types.Image | Any, metadata: Dict[str, Any] | None = None, *, kinds: Iterable[str] = ('bw', ), stats: Iterable[str] = ('mean', 'median', 'max', 'min', 'std', 'p95', 'p5', 'p99'), philips: bool = False, revert_scaling: bool = False) -> Dict[str, float]

   Compute SUV statistics restricted to ``mask > 0``.

   :param pet: PET image (raw scanner counts unless *revert_scaling* is used).
   :param mask: Mask image/array with same shape as *pet*.
   :param metadata: DICOM-style metadata. Defaults to ``pet.metadata`` when available.
   :param kinds: Iterable of SUV kinds (``bw``/``lbm``/``bsa``/``ibw``).
   :param stats: Per-kind stats to compute (same names as :func:`nvitk.measure.masked_stats`).
   :param philips: Enable the Philips ``(7053,1000)`` short-circuit for SUVbw.
   :param revert_scaling: If True, undo per-slice rescaling before applying the SUV factor.

   :returns: ``{'SUVbw_mean': ..., 'SUVbw_max': ..., 'SUVlbm_mean': ...}``.
   :rtype: dict[str, float]


.. py:function:: volume_cc(mask: nvitk.types.Image | Any, *, spacing: tuple[float, Ellipsis] | None = None) -> float

   Return the mask's volume in cubic centimetres (mL).


.. py:function:: volume_mm3(mask: nvitk.types.Image | Any, *, spacing: tuple[float, Ellipsis] | None = None) -> float

   Return the number of non-zero voxels in *mask* × voxel volume (mm^3).


.. py:function:: mean_flow_ml_s(flow_t, temporal_resolution_s: float | None = None)

   Time-mean flow proxy (same units as *flow_t* per frame).


.. py:function:: pulsatility_index(flow_t, *, eps: float = 1e-09)

   PI = (max_t - min_t) / mean(Q) per row on non-negative flow.

   Absolute value is applied so signed through-plane polarity does not invert
   the denominator. Prefer abs'ing ``Q(t)`` once upstream when possible.


.. py:function:: resistivity_index(flow_t, *, eps: float = 1e-09)

   RI = (max_t - min_t) / max(|flow|) per row.


.. py:function:: through_plane_velocity_series(vx, vy, vz, *, i: int, j: int, k: int, tangent)

   Time series of velocity projected onto unit *tangent* at voxel (i,j,k).


.. py:function:: velocity_mm_s_from_phases(ap, rl, fh)

   PC velocity components in mm/s (same convention as :mod:`nvitk.io.conversors.phase2volume`).


.. py:function:: confusion_counts(label_true: Any, label_pred: Any) -> dict[str, int]

   Return ``{'TP','TN','FP','FN'}`` counts from two binary masks.


.. py:function:: dice(label_true: Any, label_pred: Any) -> float

   Dice overlap ``2·TP / (2·TP + FP + FN)`` in ``[0, 1]`` (``0.0`` when both masks are empty).


.. py:function:: fnr(label_true: Any, label_pred: Any) -> float

   False-negative rate ``FN / (FN + TP)``.


.. py:function:: fpr(label_true: Any, label_pred: Any) -> float

   False-positive rate ``FP / (FP + TN)``.


.. py:function:: jaccard(label_true: Any, label_pred: Any) -> float

   Jaccard / IoU ``TP / (TP + FP + FN)`` in ``[0, 1]``.


.. py:function:: precision(label_true: Any, label_pred: Any) -> float

   Fraction of predicted-positive voxels that are correct ``TP / (TP + FP)``.


.. py:function:: recall(label_true: Any, label_pred: Any) -> float

   Fraction of true-positive voxels that were recovered ``TP / (TP + FN)`` (sensitivity).


.. py:function:: volume_similarity(label_true: Any, label_pred: Any) -> float

   Relative volume difference ``|n_pred − n_true| / n_true`` (0 = identical volumes).


.. py:function:: voxel_metrics(label_true: Any, label_pred: Any, *, metrics: Iterable[str] | None = None) -> dict[str, float]

   Compute a named subset of voxel-based metrics.

   :param metrics: Iterable of names from
                   ``{'TP','TN','FP','FN','dice','jaccard','precision','recall','fpr','fnr','vs'}``.
                   Default: all of them.
